REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION
WEDNESDAY - AUGUST 3, 2022 - CITY HALL -
7:00
P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
AGENDA MATERIALS:
Reports and materials related to items on this Agenda are available for public inspection at the Community Development Department, Cerritos City Hall, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703, during normal business hours, 8 a.m.
to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, Telephone (562) 916-1201. Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to the Cerritos Planning Commission after distribution of the
agenda packet are available for public inspection in the Community Development Department at the above address during normal business hours as noted.
PUBLIC COMMENTS:
Public comments will be allowed on all Agenda items at the time
each matter comes up for discussion. The public comments portion of the meeting will not
exceed 45 minutes, and no speaker will be allowed more than five minutes, unless
determined appropriate by the Chair. To assist in the preparation of appropriate
responses, persons are requested to state their name and city of residence for the record.
PUBLIC HEARINGS: Public hearings will be conducted in the order indicated on the
agenda, unless otherwise directed. Conduct of public hearings will occur in substantially
the following sequence: the item to be heard is announced, public hearing is opened, and
report of written correspondence and staff report are received. Verbal testimony will occur
in the following order: those in favor of the application/item, those opposed, interested
parties, rebuttal by applicant. Speakers are requested to state their name and city of
residence for the record. After verbal testimony, the public hearing is closed and the
matter is deliberated with a determination being made or a continuation of the public
hearing.

Public Comments and Suggestions
This section is reserved for comments related to items not listed on the agenda but that are within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Commission. Comments are limited to 5 minutes per person. Public comments on agenda items will be taken at the time the item is before the Commission.
5.

MINUTES
6.
Public Hearings
6A.
Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION APPROVING WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION PERMIT 2010-3(2022) RENEWAL, A REQUEST BY APPLICANT PLANCOM, INC, ON BEHALF OF VERIZON, TO RENEW AN EXISTING WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION FACILITY ON AN INDUSTRIAL PROPERTY. THE EXISTING WIRELESS FACILITY CONTAINS TWELVE (12) PANEL ANTENNAS, SIX (6) REMOTE RADIO UNITS, THREE (2) RAY CAPS MOUNTED ON THE MONOPINE TOWER, AND LOCATED BENEATH THE MONOPINE TOWER IS AN EXISTING EQUIPMENT ENCLOSURE THAT CONTAINS TWO (2) SUPPORT EQUIPMENT CABINETS, ONE (1) GLOBAL POSITIONING ANTENNA AND ONE (1) GENERATOR FOR WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION PURPOSES. NO CHANGES ARE PLANNED FOR THE EXISTING VERIZON WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION FACILITY AS PART OF THE RENEWAL REQUEST. THE SUBJECT WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION FACILITY IS LOCATED AT 16717 NORWALK BOULEVARD, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703 AND IS ZONED INDUSTRIAL (M) (APN 7011-001-020).*
*Pursuant to Section 15301 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), this project is categorically exempt from CEQA review.

During this part of the meeting, members of the Commission report to the community on various matters of interest, including reports required by AB 1234. In addition, consensus may be given to refer potential initiatives, policies, programs, or projects to the City Council, for City Council direction
on whether to have the Commission review and advise on such initiative, policy, program, or project at a future Commission meeting. Pursuant to the provisions of the California Brown Act, there will be no discussion or action taken on any of the matters that may be presented during this agenda item.
